translations.web: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
translations.bsb: Then He added, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
translations.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
